title: Workspace is a junk drawer — apply TTLs and archive rules
what_needed: My workspace/ directory has 7+ files and subdirectories with no content lifecycle. Old mining reports sit next to new vision documents. VR_OMEGAVERSE_VISION.md (a permanent strategic doc) sits next to mining_reports/07_MASTER_SYNTHESIS.md (a 7-day ephemeral report). There's no distinction between permanent reference and temporary findings.
why: A workspace without lifecycle management inevitably becomes a junk drawer. Agents don't know what's safe to delete, what's reference material, and what's raw sediment awaiting curation. The LILY_PAD architecture's Tier 1 (raw, 7-day TTL) vs Tier 2 (curated, 30-day TTL) vs Tier 3 (permanent) distinction must be enforced.
producer_hint: Create data/entities/roc_racoon/workspace/LIFECYCLE_RULES.md defining TTL for each workspace subdirectory. Archive mining_reports/ >=7 days old to workspace/_archive/.
artifacts_requested: Archive subdirectory with old reports moved
Clear separation of permanent docs (VR vision) vs ephemeral (reports)
